churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is centralized behind well-defined modules and a framework upgrade would touch very few files, but the pervasive any in the data layer and the two DOM-level workarounds are the spots that would ripple when requirements move.

findings.issue: All API responses flow through Promise<any> and data.ts consumes them with any-typed accessors, so PokeAPI shape changes surface as runtime breakage rather than compile errors.
findings.suggestion: Define minimal response interfaces (or Zod/standard-schema validators, which createServerFn's validator() accepts) for the handful of API record shapes the app actually reads.

findings.issue: The NotFound component mutates document.title inside useEffect instead of using the router's head management, duplicating the title convention used by every other route.
findings.suggestion: Set the 404 title via the root route's head() / a notFound head mechanism so all titles flow through one code path.

findings.issue: Hash scrolling (#moves) is hand-rolled with requestAnimationFrame plus a 150 ms setTimeout retry, timing-dependent duplication of router behaviour.
findings.suggestion: Use the router's built-in scroll handling (scrollRestoration / hashScrollIntoViewOptions) or at minimum a single scroll attempt; remove the double-scroll hack.

findings.issue: idFromUrl extracts IDs with a regex over URL strings instead of the URL platform API.
findings.suggestion: Use Number(new URL(url, base).pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop()) or similar, which is robust to query strings and trailing variations.

findings.issue: The home page ships the full 1,025-species dataset plus a derived typesByName map to every client for client-side filtering; fine for the current snapshot but payload grows with the dex.
findings.suggestion: Move filtering into the server function keyed on loaderDeps (the route already uses loaderDeps), so only one 48-card page crosses the wire; or at least derive typesByName inside the single useMemo.

findings.issue: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps comment with no ESLint configured in the project — dead weight that will puzzle future readers.
findings.suggestion: Delete the comment, or configure ESLint so it's meaningful; the empty dep array is intentional.

findings.issue: nitro is pinned to a 3.0.261029-rc prerelease string.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable since this is what TanStack Start's docs currently prescribe, but track it: move to a stable nitro v3 range as soon as one is published.

findings.issue: defaultPreload: false disables link preloading globally; deliberate (avoids prefetch storms on 1,025-card lists) but undocumented in the file.
findings.suggestion: Add a one-line comment stating why preloading is off, so a future upgrade doesn't silently 'fix' it.

summary: This app is built squarely on the current stable TanStack Start v1 API set — including the June 2026 .validator() rename and the nitro/vite plugin chain — with zero discretionary dependencies and a clean three-layer data module (transport, builders, server functions) that keeps framework churn contained to a few files. The main forward-looking weaknesses are the any-typed data layer, two small DOM workarounds (document.title in NotFound, hand-rolled hash scrolling) that bypass framework facilities, and a home page that ships the entire dex to the client for filtering. Overall it would survive a framework upgrade with minimal edits.
